g.title: GEAR undefined

Strategic Domain The Strategic Domain focuses on aligning an organization's direction, priorities, capabilities, and risk posture with its core mission and vision. It translates leadership aspirations, community needs, and long-term goals into actionable strategies. This includes elements such as strategic objectives, organizational priorities, performance indicators, and value streams, ensuring that every part of the enterprise is purpose-driven and outcome-focused.
Mission & Vision Defines the organization's aspirational long-term goals and core purpose.
Strategy & Priorities Identifies the medium- to long-term outcomes and key focus areas necessary to achieve the vision.
Value Streams & Capabilities Outlines the key value flows and enabling capabilities required to deliver on the strategy and mission.
Policy & Compliance Documents the legal, regulatory, and policy frameworks guiding the organization’s operations and architecture.
Risk & Resilience Addresses the organization's ability to anticipate, mitigate, and recover from risks while maintaining operational continuity.
Roadmap Defines the key milestones, dependencies, and timelines for achieving strategic objectives and transformation initiatives.
Physical Domain Physical Domain contains all of the devices, locations, and connectivity in the system.
Machines Machines include non digital and digital machines that interact with the physical world.
Oracle Engineered Systems Oracle Exadata Database Machine Oracle SPARC Servers Oracle StorageTek Tape Solutions Oracle Sun Servers Oracle ZFS Storage Appliances
Devices Devices represent all physical devices involved in the system's operation, such as sensors and hardware endpoints.
Communications Communication represents the physical network and protocols connecting devices within locations.
Oracle Exalink
Locations Locations define geographic and logical places in the system where resources are located.
Digital Domain Software stack of the system, including the middleware, software and applications.
Application Layer Handles user-facing applications, ensuring interaction between system and users.
Oracle Cloud Applications Oracle Database Oracle E-Business Suite
Distributed Information Management Layer Oversees the efficient distribution and access of system data across modules.
Oracle Data Integrator
Service Management Layer Monitors and controls services for smooth operation and functionality.
Oracle Enterprise Manager
Software Defined Infrastructure Focuses on abstract control over underlying hardware through software.
Oracle Virtual Machine (OVM) for SPARC
Physical Layer Acts as the logical representation of the lower physical layer.
Identity Aspect Manages all identity-related elements like authentication and user properties.
Oracle Identity Cloud Service
Security Aspect Manages all identity-related elements like authentication and user properties.
Process Domain Processes of the system including supporting, strategic and operational processes.
Governance Defines rules, policies, and mechanisms established at a higher level.
Oracle Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
Innovation Management Focuses on exploring innovative improvements to system capabilities.
Oracle Analytics Cloud
Operational and Delivery Covers routine activities and day-to-day procedures within the organization.
Oracle Fusion Cloud
Risk Management Manages identification, analysis, and mitigation of risks in various operations.
Oracle Financial Services Analytical Applications
Support Includes supporting actions like troubleshooting and external/internal assistance.
Oracle Support Services
Organizational Domain People centric organizational structure of the system.
Stakeholders All stakeholders involved in decision-making and system requirements.
Oracle Community and Partners
Personas Different personas representing user groups interacting with the system.
Database Administrators IT Managers
Communication Channels Channels of communication between system users, stakeholders, and decision-makers.
Roles & Responsibilities Defines specific tasks and duties assigned to different entities.
Skills & Competencies Profiles skills and abilities required for system operations.
Oracle Certified Professionals
Structure Maps the hierarchical structure of the organization supporting the system.
Culture & Values Refers to the organizational culture, values, and principles guiding how operations are conducted.
Oracle Culture
